summary: Hiccup tries to prove himself during a dragon raid on Berk, accidentally shooting down a mysterious Night Fury.
narration_script: Berk is a sturdy village where we do not run from dragon fights.
Young Hiccup wants to show his worth, but he always ends up in the way.
Chief Stoick leads the warriors to protect the food stores from the beasts.
hook: Berk is a sturdy village where we do not run from dragon fights.
